title: Audiobook-calibrated sentence-envelope inference from MEG
disposition_reason: The complete24-person/2880-interval programme recipe and scorer exist, but authenticated packets and an admitted executable environment are absent. The concrete target is unseen-sentence acoustic-envelope reconstruction after same-person audiobook calibration, not a decoder fitted without that person.

scientific_target.question: For each person, how accurately can that person’s labeled audiobook MEG calibration support sample-aligned acoustic-envelope inference from separate OLSA sentence MEG?
scientific_target.known_answer: The source processed acoustic-envelope time series over each complete OLSA interval; this measured stimulus target is separate from the source paper’s published aggregate result.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Source processed OLSA envelopes aligned to recorded MEG under the pinned author timing/preprocessing recipe; restricted raw OLSA audio is not required by this target.
scientific_target.case_unit: One participant episode with120 scored sentence intervals; every sample in each retained interval is scored.
scientific_target.independent_unit: 24 participants; repeated presentations of70 shared sentence identities and nested runs remain dependent.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective within-person cross-task decoding with labeled audiobook calibration; scores quantify acoustic-envelope prediction, not semantic comprehension or unaided waveform interpretation.
exclusions: No cross-person decoder generalization without calibration is established.
No causal or online inference: continuous filtering and duration+0.5s poststimulus access are declared.
No native/no-tools understanding, original-paper metric reproduction, human-level performance or hidden-holdout claim.

inputs: Per-person labeled audiobook MEG/envelope calibration from all source-declared retained whole runs, using training-only model selection and normalization.
Query306-channel MEG in original channel order,64Hz after declared MaxFilter/FieldTrip0.5–4Hz processing and+3 raw1000Hz samples latency adjustment; complete sentence intervals and boundaries.
forbidden_inputs: Held sentence envelopes or audio/MISC channels; sentence/text/playlist identity, intelligibility, SNR, event-onset tables and original source filenames.
Other participants’ calibration, held-label feedback, query-fitted normalization and cross-query fitted state outside the frozen protocol.
observation_contract.case_identity: Current source emits sub-XX:sentence-NNN in source order; private target-independent aliases/order are required before participant delivery, preserving120 exact interval boundaries per person.
observation_contract.split: Train/tune within each person on complete audiobook-run groups, then evaluate all separate OLSA intervals. All70 OLSA identities stay out of labeled calibration. All24 people are reported equally; this is not an outer held-person model-training split.
observation_contract.coverage: Specified24 people ×120 intervals=2880 nested scored observations,94 source runs in corrected design; authenticated complete packets are not delivered. Eleven comparison panels are conditions within this single task.

primary.name: person_macro_mean_sentence_fisher_z_spearman
primary.aggregation: Compute signed Spearman per complete interval with average ties; finite Fisher transform; equal mean over120 interval trials/person, then equal mean over24 people.
primary.rationale: Matches the actual scorer and weights people equally while retaining every sentence trial; source paper padding/pooled reproduction and unique-stimulus averaging are distinct estimators.

secondary: Raw signed Spearman and Pearson per interval/person; coverage and constant-prediction counts.
Matched neural-versus-no-neural contrasts; disclose all panel outcomes and the permitted method/tool access.

comparators.name: training_only_neural_decoder
comparators.inputs: Same person’s permitted audiobook neural/envelope calibration and query MEG.
comparators.procedure: Predeclare a train-only mTRF/ridge family with whole-run validation; source reference machinery exists but empirical competence is unqualified.

comparators.name: no_neural_audiobook_prior
comparators.inputs: Same audiobook targets and permitted interval support, without query MEG.
comparators.procedure: Freeze a target-time prior under matched calibration/budgets; quantify how much score can follow acoustic regularity or interval duration alone.

comparators.name: disclosed_half_shift_diagnostic
comparators.inputs: The same query MEG after the public within-interval half-shift.
comparators.procedure: Retain as robustness condition only: an actor may invert the disclosed transform, so success is not evidence against neural dependence.

nuisance_controls: Preserve sentence duration and true sample boundaries; never pad artificial zero tails into scoring.
Fit normalization and model selection on complete audiobook runs only; no source-global normalization across query data.
Treat repeated/shared sentences as dependency groups and strip their identities from the participant view.
Authenticate3ms alignment and source snapshot equivalence before target packaging.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report participant paired effects and repeated-stimulus dependence. The scorer supplies no population CI; a future inference procedure must account for shared sentence identity and full episode fitting.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all24 files and exact120 IDs/boundaries each before private target access; missing/duplicate/nonfinite rows invalidate complete coverage. Constant predictions are valid and score0 correlation; constant targets invalidate the operator packet.

implementation.scorer_target: Sample-aligned observed acoustic envelope using interval Spearman and person-macro Fisher-z; not a source-paper table reconstruction.
implementation.delivered_scope: Complete-scope scoring, reference and investigation source exists. The public entry explicitly refuses unqualified execution; source recipes do not constitute authenticated cohort packets.
missing: Complete source-prepared and authenticated24-person packets with protected target maps.
Admitted execution engine, fit/query state isolation, measured resource envelope and independent scorer/reference execution.
Target-independent participant identity/order projection and exposure audit.
implementation.execution_evidence: Metric/control corrections explicitly report no runtime/scientific execution. No new arrays, targets or model outputs were accessed for this review.

direct_observation.representation: A numerical or plotted complete sentence MEG observation could support a separate no-tools response condition.
direct_observation.boundary: Must retain identical interval support/calibration information while preventing code, fitted decoder calls and source identity access.
missing: No direct response renderer/collection protocol or model trial for this task.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential channel/time rendering of complete306-channel sentence MEG with typed navigation.
typed_viewer.boundary: Typed image-only actions would need fixed content/precision and complete response collection; current numerical tools are not this viewer.
missing: No typed renderer or participant transport supplied.

tool_assisted.representation: Fresh per-case investigation loop with bounded numerical Python tools and a submitted inference program.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same admitted inputs/tools/compute as comparator; engine must enforce target and other-query exclusion; returned text tools are not direct observation.
missing: Actual engine/provider/isolation qualifications and authenticated operands.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted method with training-only calibration and declared inference procedure.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze source/fit rules before held observations; fresh per-person state, no query fitting or target feedback.
missing: Runnable admission profile and complete authenticated packets; CLI currently refuses.

evidence.supports: Complete24-person/120-interval scope, same-person audiobook calibration, target-free306-channel observation, preprocessing and output protocol.
Signed complete-interval Spearman/Fisher aggregation and constant-vector conventions.
120 interval-trial weighting, not70 unique stimulus weighting; source order needs target-independent aliases.
Public half-shift is invertible robustness condition, not neural-information-removal null.
Bounded fresh tool-use loop exists as source; engine isolation separate.
Installed CLI refuses unqualified operation before opening scientific operands.
Official subject-level audiobook-to-OLSA decoding; original padding/normalization differ from benchmark estimator.

evidence.supports: Original participant/task collection; public development provenance, not a hidden test set.

evidence.locator: speech/decoding/training_decoding.m and preprocessing scripts; mirrored source inspected
evidence.supports: Within-participant calibration, waveform decoding and author preprocessing lineage.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: This revision inspected source and existing construction evidence only. The four historical neural programme attempts concern NEURAL-007 and NEURAL-077, not this task; no direct-observation or typed-viewer model result is asserted here.
excluded_claims: No cross-person decoder generalization without calibration is established.
No causal or online inference: continuous filtering and duration+0.5s poststimulus access are declared.
No native/no-tools understanding, original-paper metric reproduction, human-level performance or hidden-holdout claim.

summary: Correct the split claim to same-person audiobook calibration and unseen-sentence transfer.
Bind the primary to120 interval-trial Spearman/Fisher weighting and preserve shared-stimulus dependence.
Classify the disclosed half-shift as invertible robustness, not a neural-removal null.
Separate source-available computational modes from undelivered direct/viewer conditions.
revision.source_review: Inspected original registered definition, implementation source and source-bound scientific corrections. Primary-source citations reuse verified source provenance; publisher web checks were unavailable and do not add new source validation.
